(23) A reply that points a call to a sticky, a pinned thread or a megathread that already exists reports a line made before the reply, at an hour the line does not show. So the first line cannot be placed against the call, as G45 reading 12 places a reported act (unitedkingdom-034 c0028, h+4.48, then c0030, h+4.79, pointing to the sticky: J). Applied to rows already written and not yet built: a scripted look at the order rows in A20-inst-spec-1 to -4 for such replies finds two, pokemon-046 (c0494 points to an existing megathread) and singapore-044 (c0131 points to the pinned thread). Both move from O-A to J. A20-inst-spec-4-v2.txt and A20-tags-4-v2.txt supersede the first files, which stay. The others stand: they route to an existing call thread (dbz-065), to the call thread itself (japan-042; nyjets-048), to a sticky made after the call (floridagators-034; scotland-064; sixers-062; southafrica-060), or to the major canvas threads (malaysia-050). A reply that routes a call to an existing call thread or to another room's canvas sub is the line itself (dbz-065; stardustcrusaders-073 c0007; canada-043; thenetherlands-065). (24) A moderator's notice whose words name the requests for help the room received, and then the removal of such threads, shows the order in its words (startrek-042 c0124, h+70.81: O-H, MW). A complaint whose words name the defend requests, after a megathread whose words name only the mass of threads, cannot place the named calls against the megathread (unturned-046 c0113, h+57.43, then c0140, h+72.70: J). (25) A member's dismissal of the canvas drama or of the flag invasions is P20's lower range (G26's reading of worth). So where it comes before the line's first call, the line shows the bound's pattern (sweden-057 c0189, h+23.12, then c0701, h+67.93; trees-048 c0383, h+46.12, then c0386, h+46.53: BOUND). (26) These show the order in the thread (O-A, MW): stardustcrusaders-073 c0006 then c0007; starvstheforcesofevil-045 c0226 then c0227; thenetherlands-065, a call by a writer who also posts in r/borussiadortmund (so VC), then the moderator's routing c0349; wow-071 c0263 then c0265, an objection to duplicate posts; and xcom-061, the alert c0082 (h+64.16) above c0088 (R). One end shows in stevenuniverse-048, straya-056 (after the close), suomi-050, tampabaylightning-054 (an objection in reply to a post that is not coded), texas-051 (an invitation into a canvas sub is the line, not a call), tf2-050, thesilphroad-054 (a question about room is a proposal), toolband-060, turkey-066 (a megathread whose words name attacks, not calls) and uiuc-038 (after the close) (ONE). G52's readings 27 to 31, stated while reading A20's restrict window r567_000 (15 lines, with each line's full how), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (27) Restrict lines are ruled by G9 with G52's classes. S-O-A, S-O-H and S-BOUND are specifications; EL-J, EL-NC, EL-NL, EL-ONE and EL-AFTER are evidence limits (kind none); NONPORTABLE lines are particulars. The connection counts an order, not a cause, so it holds a condition that the record does not show a flood of calls causing the line. Where the first line answers no flood, the falsifier's second clause, recorded present, holds it too, and the census marks the line NF (49ers-062, MMA-050, Northwestern-061, anarcho_capitalism-070, androidgaming-039). G26's reading of removals holds a condition that a removal follows a format rule: Rainbow6-046 c0010, a removal for capitals, is moderation as such, and that line's first line is the objection c0285. (28) A question that asks members to join or act asks for hands, so it is a call (49ers c0016, whether members want to coordinate a work; aceattorney c0028, a proposal to work together on a picture). A question whether the room will make a work, or why it has not, is a proposal (reading 2). (29) A canvas-born room's founding post, its venues and its move to a new sub draw no line (G26's reading of canvas subs), so its lines show calls with no line (AvoArmy-037; EraseThePlace-053; Thegreatblackhole-036: EL-ONE). A sticky made in another sub by that sub's moderator is that sub's line (FederationPlace-060 c0060: EL-ONE). A reserved canvas sub that receives no talk, with members keeping the talk in the host, draws no line (TheB1G-050: EL-ONE). (30) A moderator's ruling that a visitor's canvas posts are not spam and may stay is P20 (G26's reading of other subs and moderators), but with no call in the line it shows one end (Okami-057 c0043: EL-ONE). A request after the close, answered by the close, shows one end (adventuretime-050: EL-ONE). (31) Unstickying a canvas thread is P20 (G26, androidgaming-038), and where it follows the call by the hours it shows the order, marked NF (androidgaming-039 c0001, h+7.93, then c0018, h+57.57: S-O-H). A complaint that the craze fills the subs a member follows, after the room's calls, shows the order by the hours (alberta-040 c0006, h+26.83, then c0037, h+70.56: S-O-H, MW). These show the order in the thread (S-O-A, R): 49ers c0016 above c0018, a sticky; MMA c0439 above c0445, a sticky; Northwestern c0031 above c0037, a question of worth; Rainbow6 c0284 above c0285, an objection to spamming; aceattorney c0028 above c0075, a routing reply; and anarcho_capitalism c0095 above c0096, a dismissal.
